### 2026-10-22 – ![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XayCiAhQWf9BX0H53Y3OjyXgaSMoKWUB/ce8a65fc70b3289ab6dcaecb7a642544bda0faf54ae272ec5629d7e0da204464.png)

**0.7h**

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/XayCiAhQWf9BX0H53Y3OjyXgaSMoKWUB/ce8a65fc70b3289ab6dcaecb7a642544bda0faf54ae272ec5629d7e0da204464.png)

Today I completed the schematic side of my keyboard while making a few changes. Firstly, I decided to double the octaves to allow better playing of most melodies. This meant that I had to house 24 (+4) switches, but obviously my microcontroller wouldn't have enough pins, so I managed them using a matrix system.

A problem I experienced with the ERC was that 2 pins were overlapping. There was no visual connection and I still don't understand why. However, it appears to be a problem with the imported chip symbol, which did not assign numbers to each pin.
